The German Diabetes Center (DDZ), Leibniz Institute for Diabetes Research at the Heinrich Heine University (HHU) Düsseldorf is an interdisciplinary research institute that links basic and clinical sciences to improve prevention, diagnosis and therapy of Diabetes mellitus and its complications. The Junior Research Group Crosstalk (head: Dr. Melanie Mittenbühler) at the Institute for Clinical Biochemistry and Pathobiochemistry focuses on how inter-tissue communication impacts energy balance and metabolic health. We are seeking a talented and highly motivatedPostdoctoral Fellow (PhD/Dr. rer. nat., m/f/div., E13 TV-L 100%) to join our research group. Our group investigates how skeletal muscle acts as an endocrine organ and communicates with other tissues through secreted signaling molecules, particularly myokines. In the ERC Starting Grant project MYOSCAN, we systematically investigate how exercise and age-related muscle loss alter the skeletal muscle secretome. We aim to identify novel exercise-sensitive myokines and define their roles in sarcopenia, metabolic disease, and cancer biology. A central question is whether muscle-derived factors promote or suppress tumor growth and how these signaling pathways can be therapeutically targeted.PhD in molecular biology, cell biology, biochemistry, physiology, exercise science, metabolism, cancer biology, or a related fieldStrong expertise in at least one of the following areas: proteomics/mass spectrometry, secretome analysis, cell biology, molecular signaling, metabolic research, or cancer biology. You will be able to learn state-of-the-art methodologies in a team of young scientists. Initially, the position is to be awarded for 2 years starting from 01.03.2027 or later. An extension of the contract period is envisaged. The employment contract is governed by TV-L in its current version for North Rhine-Westphalia, including the special regulations regarding the scientific area. The salary is based on qualification and experience, according to TV-L.Females are especially encouraged to apply, and in the case of equal qualification, handicapped persons will be given preference. jobs.description: Ihre AufgabenThe University of Bonn is an international research university offering a broad range of subjects. Ecological Labour Regimes of the Palm Oil Value Chain (PALMWORK)PALMWORK examines the relationship between labour and the environment along the palm oil value chain, particularly in the areas of production (plantations and oil mills) and social reproduction. The project is designed as a qualitative comparative analysis of case studies from Northeast India, Ghana and Colombia. It builds on re-search from the fields of labour regime analysis, (feminist) labour geography, environmental labour studies and political ecology on the materiality of nature and the society–nature metabolism. The project is being carried out as part of the DFG Priority Programme 2575 'Sustainability and Resilience of Agri-Food Chains' and consists of three sub-projects located at the University of Bonn, the Free University of Berlin and the University of Kassel. Czech Republic (Odborová organizace): Lead the relationship with the Works Councils.- Harmonization: Ensure a consistent social strategy across Germany & CEE cluster while respecting local legislative nuances.Employment Law AdvisoryLegal Business Partner: Serve as the primary legal advisor to the HR Country - Individual Labor Law: Manage complex individual cases across the region: drafting termination notices, negotiating mutual separation agreements (Aufhebungsverträge / Mutual Termination Agreements), and handling disciplinary measures.- Contracts: Maintain and update standard employment contract templates for Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic to ensure they remain compliant with the latest local case law.Restructuring & Strategic Projects- Transformation Support: Legally structure and execute organizational changes across the region (e.g.,§613a BGB transfers in Germany, AVRAG transfers in Austria).- Compliance: Roll out Group compliance policies (GDPR, Whistleblowing, Code of Conduct) ensuring they meet the strict data privacy standards of Germany and the specific requirements of the Austrian market.Litigation Management- Dispute Resolution: Represent the company in labor court proceedings (Kündigungsschutzklagen) in Germany.- External Supervision: Select and manage external legal counsel in Austria, Romania and Czech Republic for specific litigation or high-risk cases, ensuring cost control and alignment with Group strategy.Who are we looking forExperience & Qualifications- 8 to 10+ years of experience in Labor Law/Social Affairs, preferably within an international matrix organization, an IT/Consulting firm, or a specialized law firm.- Works Council Leadership: Mandatory experience leading negotiations with Works Councils.- You must have deep expertise in the German Betriebsverfassungsgesetz.- You must have experience or a strong capability to manage Austrian employee representation bodies.- Regional Scope: Proven ability to manage legal topics across multiple jurisdictions (Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic).Competencies- Negotiation Skills: Ability to lead social dialogue in four different legal environments (example: co-determination of Germany).- Pragmatism: Solution-oriented mindset; you enable business while managing risk.- Languages: German (Native level) and English (Fluent) are required. French is a plus.Perks & Benefits- Regional Responsibility: A key role covering four distinct countries with strategic importance.- Autonomy: You will be the lead expert for the region Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic, trusted to handle sensitive negotiations with the collaboration of the HR Country Manager.- Transformation: The opportunity to accompany a high-growth group in structuring its social foundations in the German & CEE market.Ergänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte Personen

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You lead the commodity agenda for electrical insulation and copper materials for Large Generator products. From your base in Bucharest or Mülheim, you orchestrate the commodity circle, align closely with Engineering, Quality, and Operations, and turn market insight into resilient sourcing strategies and supplier agreements that secure capacity, reduce risk, and deliver measurable cost and sustainability impact. How You’ll Make an Impact* Developing and implementing the Commodity Strategy for Large Generator portfolio in alignment with Global Commodity Strategy for Electrical Insulation components e.g. Insulating Tapes (Mica, OCP, ICP etc.), Rigid Components like Prepreg, Rings, EPGx (sheets and machined profiles), Ropes, Tubes and Laminates. Additionally responsible for commodity management of Copper based material like Copper Flats, Insulated Flat Wires, Sheets, Profiles etc. in machined form. * Lead the Commodity Circle and drive the end to end strategic procurement cycle: market analysis & scouting, should cost insights, negotiation planning, eSourcing events, award proposals, and sourcing board preparations. * Secure capacity and supply resilience via frame contracts, price lists, and multi sourcing strategies; identify and mitigate risks (e.g., tariff exposure, single source, capacity constraints) and ensure continuity for critical Large Generator demand. * Deliver measurable value (CNI/savings, total cost improvements, inventory and cash objectives) and maintain transparent KPIs and spend dashboards for your area. * Drive early supplier involvement with Engineering and SQD to accelerate NPI/continuous improvement, quality robustness, and manufacturability—translating field and supply market feedback into actionable design-to-value measures. * Manage strategic supplier relationships: performance reviews, joint improvement roadmaps, and executive governance with top suppliers in EMEA and beyond. What You Bring* Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain/Procurement, or Business—plus professional experience in direct material commodity management or category management in an industrial/manufacturing setting. * Familiarity with generator insulation systems and copper products (e.g., profiles, bars, wire, sheet) or adjacent electrical materials. Experience turning technical specs into sourcing strategies is key. * Supplier market analysis & scouting, cost modeling/should cost, competitive tendering, fact based negotiations, contracting (frame agreements/price lists), and risk management. * Proven ability to lead cross functional commodity teams (Commodity Circle) and influence at multiple levels, internally and at suppliers. * Proficiency with ERP/MRP and eSourcing platforms; comfort with KPI dashboards and data driven decisions. (Experience within Siemens Energy procurement frameworks is a plus.) * Professional fluency in English & German required for stakeholder and supplier interactions; Willingness to travel (~10–20%) for supplier visits and cross site collaboration.About the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbaticalWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
